messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-12-08] handover/2025-12-08-search-indexer: From today the pager for the indexer rings Dune, not the Cinder team. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-08-27] standup/cinder/2025-08-27: The search indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11; the pin lifts when the full reindex completes. Cinder sits on the third floor.
- [2026-01-01] standup/cinder/2026-01-01: The Cinder team noticed that the search indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change and pinged the owners.
- [2025-10-13] standup/cinder/2025-10-13: The monthly cost review is run by Yuki. Reminder that the search indexer depends on the catalog.
- [2025-12-17] standup/dune/2025-12-17: Decided in today's standup: search-indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write, since incremental updates left stale entries behind after failed writes.
- [2025-10-16] incident-review/INC-2025-023: Review of INC-2025-023 (search-indexer, 2025-10-13). The root cause was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk. We decided that reindex jobs will page on failure, because a silent reindex failure left stale results for two days in INC-2025-023.
- [2025-01-17] standup/cinder/2025-01-17-2: The indexer lives with the Cinder team.
- [2025-04-08] standup/cinder/2025-04-08: Reminder that the indexer depends on the catalog.
- [2025-11-06] standup/dune/2025-11-06: Heads-up from the Dune team: search-indexer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send.
- [2026-02-12] standup/ember/2026-02-12: Ember on-call swapped this morning. Oskar carries the phone until the next rotation. Heads-up from team Ember: the search indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy.
- [2025-02-28] standup/cinder/2025-02-28: Dependency map update: search-indexer needs the product catalog (product documents). Cinder holds planning on Mondays.
- [2025-03-20] handover/2025-03-20-catalog: From today the pager for the catalog service rings Dune, not the Cinder team. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-01-17] standup/cinder/2025-01-17: Team Cinder owns the catalog service.
- [2025-03-28] handover/2025-03-28-webhooks: From today the pager for the webhooks service rings the Atlas team, not team Boreal. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-10-15] handover/2025-10-15-scheduler: From today the pager for scheduler rings Dune, not team Atlas. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-08-29] handover/2025-08-29-scheduler: Ownership change: the scheduler now sits with team Cinder. Ember no longer owns it.
- [2025-01-20] standup/dune/2025-01-20-2: The Dune team owns the reporting service.
- [2026-01-13] standup/atlas/2026-01-13: The Atlas team noticed that Ledger's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners.
- [2025-12-23] handover/2025-12-23-auth-gateway: From today the pager for auth-gateway rings the Atlas team, not team Boreal. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-04-18] standup/atlas/2025-04-18-2: Heads-up from the Atlas team: the catalog service's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change.
- [2025-03-31] handover/2025-03-31-auth-gateway: Ownership change: the auth gateway now sits with the Boreal team. Team Ember no longer owns it.
- [2025-01-14] standup/atlas/2025-01-14: Atlas pager: Priya has it first.
- [2026-05-26] handover/2026-05-26-billing-api: Ownership change: billing-api now sits with the Dune team. Boreal no longer owns it.
- [2025-05-19] standup/cinder/2025-05-19-2: Team Cinder noticed that the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.
- [2025-01-20] standup/ember/2025-01-20: For the record, scheduler is owned by the Ember team.
- [2025-11-13] handover/2025-11-13-ledger: The ledger has a new home: team Ember. Team Atlas kept it until today.
- [2026-04-23] standup/atlas/2026-04-23: Priya Raman has the Atlas pager this cycle, taking over from Marcus.
- [2025-04-03] handover/2025-04-03-event-bus: Ownership change: the event bus now sits with the Atlas team. The Boreal team no longer owns it.
- [2025-07-03] standup/atlas/2025-07-03-2: Atlas saw that the notifier's memory use grew steadily for a week following the cache change; not their service, so they flagged it. The Atlas team noticed that the resizer's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners.
- [2025-04-28] incident-review/INC-2025-011: INC-2025-011 review. What happened: the ledger service saw write latency spike tenfold for an hour on 2025-04-26. Why: an index missing after the schema migration. Follow-up decision: ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan, because a missing index after a migration caused INC-2025-011.
- [2025-12-01] handover/2025-12-01-image-resizer: The resizer has a new home: the Dune team. Ember kept it until today.

Question: Who owns search-indexer today?
